items.raw_excerpt: Hotel and guesthouse stays by Icelandic residents have fallen steadily in recent years, with overnight stays down 27 per cent over the past four years. The decline comes as more travellers choose alternative accommodation, including campsites, mountain huts, private homes and Airbnb. What’s the Story? Original source: RÚV Icelandic hotel and guesthouse nights have fallen…
items.summary_en: Hotel and guesthouse stays by Icelandic residents have fallen steadily in recent years. Overnight stays are down 27 per cent over the past four years. More travellers now choose campsites, mountain huts, private homes and Airbnb instead.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드 현지인의 호텔과 게스트하우스 숙박이 최근 몇 년 사이 꾸준히 줄어들고 있다. 지난 4년 동안 숙박 횟수가 27% 감소했다. 더 많은 여행자가 캠핑장, 산속 오두막, 개인 주택, 에어비앤비 같은 대안 숙소를 선택하고 있다.
items.title_en: Icelanders Spend Fewer Nights in Hotels

items.title_original: Travel Habits Shift: Icelanders Spend Fewer Nights in Hotels

items.raw_excerpt: It’s this time of the year when Iceland and its capital get brighter and more flamboyant. The key event of Reykjavík Pride is the parade, taking place today at 14.00. The event is initiated by the Reykjavík Pride organisation, encouraging participants to highlight issues affecting LGBTQ people. The coordinators say creativity and imagination are more…
items.summary_en: This time of year, Iceland and its capital get brighter and more colorful. The main event of Reykjavík Pride is the parade, starting today at 14.00. Organizers encourage participants to highlight issues that affect LGBTQ people.

items.title_ko: 레이캬비크 프라이드 행진 시작
items.title_original: All Colours of Rainbow: Reykjavík Pride Parade Starts Today

items.raw_excerpt: Los municipios de interior de la Comunitat Valenciana, preparados para recibir el mayor pico de visitantes en busca del mejor lugar. Más información: Un experto da las claves del eclipse solar: "Hará entre 2 y 5 grados menos y conviene planear con antelación"

items.title_en: Astronomy village in Valencia ready for its biggest eclipse crowd

items.raw_excerpt: Mr Jamsairi "Bobby" Kamaruddin first fell in love with lion dance at the age of eight. Decades later, together with his children, he is running a successful troupe with mostly Malay members, in a performance art rooted in Chinese culture.
items.summary_en: Mr Jamsairi 'Bobby' Kamaruddin fell in love with lion dance at age eight. Now, with his children, he runs a lively troupe with mostly Malay members. Lion dance is rooted in Chinese culture, which makes his troupe special.

items.raw_excerpt: As schools increasingly rely on digital learning, mother-of-three Wang Yingyu argues that the level of screen time devoted to schoolwork deserves just as much scrutiny as recreational use, especially for younger children.
items.summary_en: Wang Yingyu, a mother of three, says schools are using digital learning more and more. She thinks screen time for schoolwork needs as much attention as screen time for play. She says this matters most for younger children.
items.summary_ko: 세 아이를 키우는 왕잉유 씨는 학교의 디지털 학습이 늘어나면서 숙제를 위한 화면 시간도 놀이용 화면 시간만큼 주목해야 한다고 말한다. 특히 어린아이일수록 그 기준이 더 중요하다고 강조한다.
items.title_en: Mum of 3: schoolwork on devices should count as screen time

items.title_original: As a mum of 3, I think doing schoolwork on devices should count under screen time guidelines

items.summary_en: Boca Juniors signed Ecuadorian star Enner Valencia. River Plate brought in Argentine Thiago Almada. Both teams added World Cup players to their squads.

items.raw_excerpt: Iidealizador do projeto, o cellista inglês David Chew, radicado no Brasil há mais de 40 anos, mantém a intenção de popularizar a música clássica.
items.summary_en: The Rio Cello Festival takes classical music to several places across Rio de Janeiro. Its founder, English cellist David Chew, has lived in Brazil for over 40 years. He wants to make classical music popular.
items.summary_ko: 리우 첼로 축제가 리우데자네이루의 여러 장소에서 클래식 음악을 선보입니다. 이 프로젝트를 만든 영국 출신 첼리스트 데이비드 츄는 브라질에서 40년 넘게 살고 있습니다. 그는 클래식 음악을 대중화하려는 뜻을 이어가고 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Este sábado, tras su viaje desde Chile, Las Diablas tuvieron su primera práctica en Amsterdam, Países Bajos, de cara al Mundial de Hockey Césped, donde debutarán ante el cuadro local el próximo sábado 15 de agosto a las 10:00 horas de nuestro país (14:00 GMT).
items.summary_en: Las Diablas, Chile's women's field hockey team, arrived in Amsterdam from Chile. They had their first practice ahead of the Field Hockey World Cup. They will play their first match against the host team Netherlands next Saturday, August 15.

items.raw_excerpt: The success of the first Fleadh Cheoil na hÉireann in Belfast has been described as a "dream come true" for organisers.
items.summary_en: The first Fleadh Cheoil na hÉireann in Belfast drew more than one million visitors. Organisers called the success a dream come true. It is Ireland's biggest festival of traditional music and dance.

items.raw_excerpt: Dos 512 postos listados no portal De Olho Na Fila, apenas 62 estavam abertos neste sábado (8). O funcionamento de todos ocorre somente de segunda a sexta-feira.
items.summary_en: Only 62 of the 512 measles vaccine sites listed on the De Olho Na Fila portal were open this Saturday. The sites only run from Monday to Friday. People in Sao Paulo faced long lines to get the measles vaccine.
items.summary_ko: De Olho Na Fila 포털에 등록된 홍역 백신 접종소 512곳 가운데 이번 토요일에 문을 연 곳은 62곳뿐이었다. 접종소는 월요일부터 금요일까지만 운영한다. 상파울루 시민들은 홍역 백신을 맞기 위해 긴 줄을 섰다.
items.title_en: Only 62 measles vaccine sites open on Saturday in Sao Paulo
